links.outcome: AI vs expert endoscopist diagnostic performance for polyp histology prediction
links.effect: Sensitivity 80% (AI) vs 88% (endoscopists), P<0.05; specificity 83% for both; accuracy 81% vs 86%. AI classified 22 of 23 sessile serrated lesions as hyperplasia; endoscopists correctly classified 16 of 23.
links.quote: However, sensitivity was greater with endoscopists as compared with CAD EYE ( P <0.05).

screen.reason: Prospective clinical evaluation of a commercial CAD system (CAD EYE) during colonoscopies measuring diagnostic accuracy compared to expert endoscopists, without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
